description: PBM-prefixed names grandfathered in the public Swift surface (shrink-only). Fixing one means renaming the Swift symbol and deprecating the old name (deprecation-hygiene applies). PBMMediation* constants are NOT here — they are a permanent, documented exception encoded in the check itself.

entries.reason: Migration leftover: public Swift name still carries the ObjC PBM prefix. Renaming it is a breaking public-API change.
